mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_permission_template_version (id, template_id, version_number, status, published_at) VALUES (#{version.versionId}, #{version.templateId}, #{version.versionNumber}, #{version.status}, CASE WHEN #{version.status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END)
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_permission_template_version SET template_id = #{version.templateId}, version_number = #{version.versionNumber}, status = #{version.status}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{version.status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN COALESCE(published_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{version.versionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_permission (permission_code, display_name) VALUES (#{permissionCode}, #{permissionCode}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE permission_code = VALUES(permission_code)
